title: Tofu, mushroom and peanut stir-fry
summary: Plant-based, low carb and high in protein.
steps: Drain the tofu, press it dry between paper towels and cut it into cubes. Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the mushrooms and pepper.
Heat the oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden. Lift it out onto a plate.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the same pan for 4 to 5 minutes with crushed garlic and grated ginger, adding a splash of water if they stick.
Return the tofu, add a splash of soy sauce and toss for a minute.
Chop the peanuts and scatter them over to serve.
